author: BlueberryHopes
body:
Hello, I'm BlueberryHopes on Minecraft.

I was banned due Excessive Infractions. 3 July 2015 at 4:48 PM - banned by MidnightBeth. 

My other appeal requests were denied. Ok, I have 24 infractions. But how do you know I've not learned from the amount of infractions? Because, when I sent my first appeal request after the perm ban, and it was denied, I decided to wait many months before sending another request. I've now waited long! A bit over an half a year! Please give me another chance now!

What can I do to come back?! Just be merciful and give me another chance please!

I'm not here to spam appeal requests by the way.


Regards,

BlueberryHopes

replies.author: BlueberryHopes
replies.body: Also, if you can, clear all my infraction, and let me start over.

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

Sorry for the inconvenience, however I have decided to deny your appeal. Considering that you have over 30 infractions, this shows that you purposely broke the rules over 30 times. This is quite excessive, and shouldn't be happening. However, since you have been banned for a very long time, I will consider reducing your punishment if you appeal in a few weeks.

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Administrator
